result.reason: The new insurance covenant contains every preferred coverage, limit, conditional trigger, and certificate obligation. It also necessarily satisfies the lower fallback limits. The amendment is confined to the insurance requirement, leaves the existing headings provision unchanged, and introduces no contradiction or unrelated commercial term.
